blocks.text: Greenway — Adera's Townhomes at South Ridge Club

parts.t: Greenway

is the second phase of Adera's South Ridge Club in Grandview Surrey: 67 townhomes at 2825 159 Street, completed in 2017. It was designed by Integra Architecture with interiors by Cutler, and it won two 2018 CHBA BC Georgie Awards, for Best Multi-Family Townhouse Development and Residential Community of the Year.

Homes range from about 1,550 to 1,960 square feet across three levels, with 3 or 4 bedrooms. Each has private outdoor space of up to 750 square feet, including a rooftop and a deck, and many homes have North Shore Mountain views. Kitchens have quartz countertops and five-burner gas cooktops.
Greenway owners share the South Ridge Club clubhouse, with a lounge, a theatre room, a fitness room, a 1,300 sq ft multi-purpose gymnasium, an outdoor lap pool and a hot tub.

items.t: Rooftop plus deck, up to 750 sq ft combined

parts.t: Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)

Greenway kitchens have quartz countertops, glossy tile backsplashes, stainless steel French-door refrigerators, 30-inch convection wall ovens and five-burner gas cooktops, and select homes have oversized islands.
The standout feature is the rooftop deck, which in some homes covers the entire area of the home and has plenty of coverage for year-round use.
South Ridge Club Amenities

Greenway residents share the South Ridge Club clubhouse with the other South Ridge Club phases. It has a lounge with a pool table, indoor and outdoor kitchens, a community dining table, a theatre room and a dog-washing station.
Outside are a heated lap pool and a hot tub. Downstairs, a fitness room sits next to a 1,300 sq ft two-storey gymnasium for basketball, volleyball, badminton or floor hockey.

The Neighbourhood
Greenway is directly across 159 Street from Sunnyside Elementary, and The Shops at Morgan Crossing are about 0.7 km away.
Why South Ridge Club?
South Ridge Club is made up of three Adera phases, Willsbrook, Greenway and Grandview, which share one clubhouse and amenity package.
Buyer FAQs
What is the price range for Greenway townhomes in South Surrey?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Greenway sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at Greenway?
Greenway homes range from about 1,550 to 1,960 square feet across three levels, with 3 or 4 bedrooms. Each home has up to 750 square feet of private outdoor space, including a rooftop and deck.
Does Greenway allow pets?

Most strata bylaws at Greenway permit pets with reasonable size and quantity restrictions. Always confirm current pet bylaws directly with the strata management company before purchasing, particularly if you have larger dogs or multiple animals.
Does Greenway allow rentals?

Under BC's Strata Property Act amendments effective November 24, 2022, residential strata corporations cannot restrict long-term rentals, so Greenway townhomes can be rented long term. Short-term rentals (such as Airbnb or VRBO) remain subject to strata bylaws and municipal licensing. Buyers should review the current strata bylaws, Form B, and recent strata minutes before purchasing.
What amenities does South Ridge Club include?

South Ridge Club has a clubhouse with a lounge, indoor and outdoor kitchens, a theatre room, a fitness room and a 1,300 sq ft multi-purpose gymnasium, plus a heated outdoor lap pool and hot tub. Check the current strata documents for what the monthly fees cover.
How does Greenway compare to other South Ridge Club phases?

Greenway is Phase 2, after Willsbrook (Phase 1) and before the final Grandview phase. Adera described Greenway as a step up from Willsbrook in size and specifications, with large rooftop decks. All three phases share the South Ridge Club amenity package. Jared can walk you through a detailed comparison across all three phases.
